decisionsTitle: «Voluntari»: the events' volunteers as one screen, beside «Înscrieri»; the volunteers in Excel
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-21**, from his phone, after the roles release (§837): «I also want a nicer volunteers screen, similar to the participants area». Since §754 the volunteers were read on one place only — the event editor's «Voluntari» card, the seventeenth box of a long page, one event at a time; who signed up this week across the autumn's runs, who still waits for a role, who confirmed, took a walk through every event. Amends §754 (where the people are read) and §761 (where «De repartizat» is answered).

**Decision — a section of the backoffice, `/admin/volunteers`**, the registrations list's shape (§312, `AdminTable`): the events' volunteers as one sorted, searched, server-paginated table, with a page per person. The tab «Voluntari» stands right after «Înscrieri» — the two lists of the people who come to an event — for the three roles that manage volunteers (`canManageVolunteers`: the Organizer and the Administrators, the card's gate), and for nobody else: the Tehnic role and the Redactor get no tab and a 404 on the address (BR-REQ-060-01), asserted by the page and, above the `loading.tsx` boundary, by the `(list)` layout, for the status code (the registrations list's reason, §312). Its badge is how many offers still wait for an answer — «Înscris» on an event not yet over —, memoized a minute like the registrations' (`volunteers/nav-count.ts`).

**The list.** The scope is the registrations list's (§178, §312): the featured event unless one is chosen, every event while a name is searched and none chosen, «Toate evenimentele» one press away; the select offers the events that take volunteers or have any, the featured first. The filters are a plain GET form: the name (folded like the registrations' search, `db/name-search.ts`, now shared by both: `stefan` finds «Ștefan», `Tanase» finds «Tănase»), the event, the state, and — with one event chosen — the role given, with how many hold each, or «De repartizat». The strip «Cine s-a oferit» counts the scope by state and how many wait for a role, blind to the state and the role filters (§246's rule), every pill a link that sets or clears that filter (§626). The columns: the name (the link to the person's page, «Adăugat de un organizator» when the club typed them), the state chip, «Roluri date» (or the chip «De repartizat» on an offer nobody placed; a dash on a cancelled one), «S-a oferit pentru», the event with its date, and «Ofertă din»; sorted by name, state (the card's order, never the alphabet's), event or date, newest offers first by default. Each row carries the card's state verbs — «Confirmă», «Anulează», «Înapoi la înscris» — and nothing else: the roles are given on the person's page. With one event chosen, two links above the table: «Rolurile și setările evenimentului» to the card (`#box-volunteers`) and «Descarcă CSV», the event's own file (§761).

**The person's page, `/admin/volunteers/[id]`.** The block the card draws for one person — the contact, what they said about themselves, the roles given with «Dă-i rolul …» and «Ia-i rolul …», the roles offered, the agreement and the guardian with their links and papers, the state verbs, «Modifică» — is now one component, `VolunteerPerson`, drawn by the card for each person and by this page for one, so the two never disagree about a person; the page adds the event line with the way to the card, and the way back to the list on that event. What a person's forms need of the event — the roles under their categories, how each stands today, the switches, the texts in force in each language, the clock — is gathered once (`volunteers/person-context.ts`), the same reads the editor's page makes.

**Every verb comes back to where it was pressed.** The card's forms post to the Server Actions of the event editor, which ask the service for the role again; on this screen each form adds a hidden `returnTo` — the list's page with its filters, or the person's page — and `backToCard` redirects there, the toast in the flash cookie as before and a one-button refusal's code in the address (`?volunteerError=`), which both pages say as a sentence. A `returnTo` that is not a path of this screen — another page, another host, a fragment, an id that is no uuid — is ignored and the press comes back to the event's card, so a forged field sends nobody anywhere.

**«Descarcă Excel»** (the owner, the same day: «I wanna be able to export volunteers in excel as well»). The event's file (§761) comes as a spreadsheet too: `format=xlsx` on the same route, the CSV's rows and words in the reader's language through the one writer every backoffice sheet uses (`registrations/workbook.ts#writeSheet`, `volunteers/workbook.ts`) — a bold header kept on screen, the sign-up's moment on the club's clock in the club's format, the age a number, the sheet named «Voluntari»; the columns a reader looks for first come first (the name, the state, the roles given and offered, the contact), the two free texts last; the file `voluntari-<date>.xlsx`. Excel first on the card and on the screen, because that is what somebody opens; the CSV stays, its order untouched, for whoever feeds it to something else. The same gate and the same audit row as the CSV's download; still one event per file.

**Not changed:** the card (it draws the same block, from the same component), the roles' editor, the invitations, the public form and list, the CSV, the service and its rules, who may manage volunteers, the retention.

**Refused.** Giving roles from the list's rows (one press per role per row makes a wide table; the person's page has the card's verbs in full, one link away); an export across events (the file belongs to an event, §761, and carries addresses: one race's organizer takes one race's file); adding a volunteer by hand from the list (the add form asks the event's roles; it stays on the event's card, one link away); a fourth role for the screen (it shows addresses and telephone numbers, the card's data: the card's gate is the right one).

Amends §754 and §761.
changelogLine: - **«Voluntari», a screen of its own** — the events' volunteers as one list beside «Înscrieri»: searched by name, filtered by event, state and role, a pill per state and «De repartizat», each row with the state verbs, and a page per person with everything the event's card shows for them; the tab counts the offers still waiting; and «Descarcă Excel» beside the CSV, on the card and on the screen. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given `/admin/volunteers`, then the events' volunteers are one sorted, searched, server-paginated list (`AdminTable`) for the roles `canManageVolunteers` names, a 404 for every other role by the page and by the `(list)` layout above the loading boundary; its scope is the registrations list's — the featured event unless one is chosen, every event while a name is searched and none chosen, «Toate evenimentele» on `all` —; it filters by state, by a role given of the chosen event or «De repartizat» (`role=none`), and by a name folded of its diacritics; its strip counts the scope by state and how many wait for a role, blind to the state and the role, each pill a link setting or clearing that filter; each row names the roles given and offered, the event and the date of the offer, and carries the card's state verbs; with one event chosen the page links the event's card and its CSV; `/admin/volunteers/[id]` draws `VolunteerPerson` — the card's block — for one person, a 404 for a guessed or unknown id; a verb pressed on either page comes back to it (`returnTo`, accepted only as a path of this screen), a refusal's code in `?volunteerError=`; the tab «Voluntari» counts the «Înscris» offers on the events not yet over, memoized a minute (2026-10-21, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given `/api/admin/events/[id]/volunteers?format=xlsx`, then the event's volunteers come as a spreadsheet through `writeSheet`: the CSV's columns and words in `lang`, one row per volunteer in the CSV's order, the roles given and offered joined by «, », the sign-up's moment on the club's clock, the sheet «Voluntari», the file `voluntari-<date>.xlsx`, the card's gate and audit row; without `format` the CSV is unchanged; «Descarcă Excel» stands before «Descarcă CSV» on the event's card and on the «Voluntari» screen (2026-10-21, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Voluntari», the events' volunteers as one screen, in Excel too
